phong_cach: 2D animated children's-book style history illustration, clean bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients, muted icy palette of blues and warm cream and orange accents, expressive stylized faces, hand-painted texture, no text, no watermark, not photorealistic, not 3D

nhan_vat.shackleton: Ernest Shackleton, a sturdy man of about 40 with a square jaw, short light-brown hair, clean-shaven, determined calm eyes, wearing a dark navy wool peacoat with a cream wool scarf
nhan_vat.worsley: Captain Frank Worsley, a broad round-faced man of about 42 with a thick brown moustache, friendly eyes, wearing a navy captain's cap and a dark double-breasted jacket with brass buttons
nhan_vat.hurley: Frank Hurley, the expedition photographer, lean and athletic man of about 30 with curly dark hair and stubble, wearing a thick grey knitted jumper and a leather satchel
nhan_vat.macklin: Doctor Alexander Macklin, a young man of about 27 with round wire glasses and a short brown beard, wearing a heavy brown tweed coat and a woolen hat
nhan_vat.crean: Tom Crean, a tall burly Irish sailor of about 38 with a big warm smile, thick black hair, ruddy cheeks, wearing a chunky cream fisherman's sweater and an oilskin jacket
nhan_vat.blackborow: Perce Blackborow, a thin young sailor of 18 with freckles, messy ginger hair and a shy smile, wearing a too-big dark wool coat and a flat cap
nhan_vat.endurance: the wooden three-masted polar ship Endurance, black hull with a thin white stripe, a short funnel, tall masts with furled sails, rigging covered in frost
nhan_vat.wild: Frank Wild, second-in-command, a lean weathered man of about 41 with a thin face, thinning light hair and a small moustache, wearing a worn brown wool jacket and a woolen scarf
nhan_vat.mcnish: Harry McNish, the ship's carpenter, a stern man of about 41 with a long grizzled grey beard and a flat woolen cap, wearing a patched canvas work jacket
nhan_vat.pardo: Captain Luis Pardo, a slim Chilean naval officer of about 45 with black hair and a thin black moustache, wearing a dark grey-green naval greatcoat and a white-topped officer's cap
nhan_vat.caird: the James Caird, a small open wooden whaleboat under seven metres long with a patched canvas deck and one short mast with a brown sail
nhan_vat.yelcho: the Yelcho, a small grey steam tug with one tall black funnel, a short mast and a modest wheelhouse
nhan_vat.hut: a low shelter made of two upturned wooden lifeboats propped on rough stone walls, snow banked around it
nhan_vat.dogs: a team of fluffy grey and white husky sled dogs

canh_thu.mo_ta: On the frozen deck of the ship Endurance, Shackleton and Worsley stand side by side looking out over a vast white ice pack that is closing in around the ship under a pale blue evening sky
At night on a drifting ice floe, Hurley, Crean, Macklin and Blackborow sit close around a small orange campfire beside two canvas tents, breath steaming, the dark wrecked ship far behind them
Shackleton, Worsley and Crean crowd into a small open wooden lifeboat tossed on huge grey-green ocean waves, spray flying, Shackleton gripping the side and looking forward
